project.name: Tenant audit log
project.description: Record role and billing changes per tenant, expose them in the portal and the public API, and log staff access from the admin app. Spec: specs/tenant-audit-log.md

epics.title: Audit foundations
epics.summary: Domain model, table and writer that every capture point uses.

tickets.title: Scaffold @acme/audit-domain with event schema and redaction policy
tickets.description: Create the pure domain package for audit events: an Effect Schema `AuditEvent`, the action catalogue (`member.role_changed`, `billing.plan_changed`, `staff.tenant_accessed`) and a `redact` policy that drops payment method fields. No IO; tagged `layer:domain`.

createsPackages.name: @acme/audit-domain
createsPackages.description: Pure audit event model, action catalogue and redaction policy.

acceptanceCriteria: `packages/audit-domain` exists with package.json, turbo.json tag `layer:domain` and a README, and `turbo boundaries` passes
`AuditEvent` decodes a valid event and rejects one with an unknown action (Vitest)
`redact` removes `payment_method` and `card` keys from `before` and `after` at any depth (Vitest)

tickets.title: Add audit_events table and migration
tickets.description: Additive migration in `@acme/db-schema` creating `audit_events` with the columns and indexes from the spec. Must be idempotent because the migrate runner applies it to every tenant database.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the migration twice against a fresh tenant database leaves exactly one `audit_events` table and both indexes
`EXPLAIN` of the list query `ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100` uses the `(occurred_at desc, id)` index
The migrate runner applies it to all tenant databases in staging with zero failures

tickets.title: AuditWriter service in tenant-db behind the audit-log flag
tickets.description: Add an `AuditWriter` Effect service (Context.Tag + live Layer + test Layer) that redacts and inserts an `AuditEvent` into the current tenant's database. Writes are skipped when the `audit-log` flag is off for the tenant. Failures are reported to Sentry and never fail the calling use-case.
acceptanceCriteria: `AuditWriter.record(event)` inserts one row into the current tenant's `audit_events` with redacted before/after (integration test against a Neon branch)
With the `audit-log` flag off for a tenant, `record` performs no insert (Vitest with the test Layer)
A failing insert is captured by the observability Layer as `AuditWriteError` and the caller's Effect still succeeds

epics.title: Capture changes
epics.summary: Emit audit events from the existing member and billing use-cases.

tickets.title: Emit member.role_changed from feature-members
tickets.description: Call `AuditWriter.record` from the change-role use-case with actor, target member, and before/after roles. Covers portal and API callers because both go through feature-members.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing a member's role through the use-case writes one `member.role_changed` event with the old and new role (Vitest with test Layers)
A role change that fails validation writes no event
The actor type is `api_key` when the change comes from `@acme/api` and `member` when it comes from the portal

tickets.title: Emit billing.plan_changed from feature-billing
tickets.description: Record plan changes, including the Stripe-webhook path. Payment method data must be redacted before the write.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading a plan through the use-case writes one `billing.plan_changed` event with old and new plan ids
A plan change arriving via the Stripe webhook writes an event with actor type `system`
No stored event contains a `payment_method` key (Vitest asserting on the recorded payload)

epics.title: Read surfaces
epics.summary: List, filter and export the log for tenant admins and tenant systems.

tickets.title: Scaffold @acme/feature-audit with list use-case and cursor pagination
tickets.description: New feature package exposing `listAuditEvents({ cursor, limit, actorId, action, from, to })` for the current tenant. Cursor is opaque base64 of `(occurred_at, id)`.

createsPackages.name: @acme/feature-audit
createsPackages.description: Audit log list and export use-cases for the current tenant.

acceptanceCriteria: `packages/feature-audit` exists with tag `layer:feature` and `turbo boundaries` passes
Listing 250 seeded events with limit 100 returns 3 pages with no duplicates or gaps (integration test)
Filters by actorId, action and date range each return only matching rows
limit above 500 fails with `InvalidPageSize`

tickets.title: Portal audit log page with filters
tickets.description: Server-component page at `/settings/audit-log` in apps/portal, visible to tenant admins only, with actor, action and date filters and 'load more' pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: A tenant admin sees events newest first with actor, action, target and timestamp columns
A non-admin member gets a 404 for `/settings/audit-log`
Applying a filter updates the URL query string and a reload shows the same results (Playwright)

tickets.title: GET /v1/audit-events in the public API
tickets.description: Route handler in apps/api returning `{ data, next_cursor }`. Default page size 100, max 500. Documented in the OpenAPI spec.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /v1/audit-events` with a valid API key returns 200 and at most 100 events by default
`?limit=501` returns 400 with error code `invalid_page_size`
Following `next_cursor` until null returns every event exactly once (integration test)
The endpoint appears in the generated OpenAPI document

epics.title: Staff access
epics.summary: Log support access to tenant data and let staff read a tenant's log from admin, through feature-tenants only.

tickets.title: Record staff.tenant_accessed in feature-tenants
tickets.description: Every feature-tenants use-case that opens a tenant database records a `staff.tenant_accessed` event in that tenant's log with the staff id and stated reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a tenant database through feature-tenants writes one `staff.tenant_accessed` event with actor type `staff`
A call without a reason fails with `MissingAccessReason` and writes nothing

tickets.title: Tenant audit log view in admin via feature-tenants
tickets.description: Admin page showing a tenant's audit log. Admin may not import feature-audit (rule `admin-no-tenant-scoped-features`), so feature-tenants wraps `listAuditEvents` and logs the access.
acceptanceCriteria: Support staff can open a tenant's audit log in admin after entering an access reason
Viewing the log itself creates a `staff.tenant_accessed` event in that tenant
`depcruise` passes: `@acme/admin` has no import of `@acme/feature-audit`

tickets.title: End-to-end audit test and staged rollout
tickets.description: Playwright test covering a role change in the portal showing up in the portal log and the API. Then enable the flag for internal tenants, watch Sentry for a week, and enable for the two enterprise prospects.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright: change a role in the portal, the event appears in the portal log and in `GET /v1/audit-events` within 5 seconds
The flag is on for all internal tenants and Sentry shows zero `AuditWriteError` over 7 days
The flag is on for the two enterprise prospect tenants
